release_slices.name: GitHub billing fallback governance
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Keep pull-request and production qualification usable when GitHub refuses to allocate runners, without treating failed tests as acceptable.
release_slices.purpose: Keep pull-request and production qualification usable when GitHub refuses to allocate runners, without treating failed tests as acceptable.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Updates ADR 0030 and the authoritative release workflow to permit a narrowly verified zero-runner billing lane while preserving exact-SHA local qualification, isolated QA, human review, signed authorization, and production proof.
included_features: Feature PR and signed-controller fallback rules

completed_tests.evidence: local-validation-2026-06-30: architecture guardrails PASS for 36 modules, 325 code files, and 69 controllers
local-validation-2026-06-30: no compliance-sensitive changes and API contracts PASS
local-validation-2026-06-30: full development-to-production governance suite PASS
local-validation-2026-06-30: controller positive and fail-closed billing fallback tests PASS

documentation_closure.rationale: The fallback changes release authorization semantics and therefore requires an ADR-backed, fail-closed operating contract.

documents.evidence: Defines the exact GitHub API signals, signed evidence binding, and non-bypassable gates.
Defines the operator procedure for feature PRs and signed promotion or production qualification.

release_slices.adr_or_compliance: ADR 0030 is updated because qualification trust behavior changes; no regulated product or payment behavior changes.
release_slices.rollback_notes: Disable github_actions_billing_fallback in root-owned controller configuration, restore controller 2.0.0, and require successful GitHub checks until a replacement lane is requalified.
production_proof_required: Installed controller version 2.1.0 and package checksum
Exact live GitHub job and annotation revalidation
Signed authorization and nonce ledger record
production_accuracy_checks_required: A zero-step billing failure is accepted only when all exact signals are present
A generic failure or a job that executed a step is rejected
A normal successful GitHub check remains accepted without fallback

release_slices.name: GitHub billing fallback enforcement
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Make the signed release controller independently distinguish a real GitHub billing denial from an actual failed check.
release_slices.purpose: Make the signed release controller independently distinguish a real GitHub billing denial from an actual failed check.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Adds a GitHub API evidence collector, hash-binds its report into candidate evidence, independently rechecks runner, step, application, conclusion, and annotation signals in controller 2.1.0, and adds negative-path tests.
excluded_features: Controller installation on an untrusted workstation

documentation_closure.rationale: Controller acceptance rules alter the production trust boundary and are documented in ADR 0030 and the authoritative operator workflow.

documents.evidence: Authorizes only exact zero-runner billing allocation evidence as a check-location substitute.

release_slices.adr_or_compliance: ADR 0030 governs this controller change; compliance checks must confirm no payment or regulated runtime surface changed.
release_slices.rollback_notes: Set github_actions_billing_fallback.enabled to false or restore controller 2.0.0; preserve reports and signed records for audit.
production_proof_required: Trusted Linux controller installation record for version 2.1.0
Controller dry run using an exact-SHA billing-unavailability report
Negative dry run proving generic failures remain blocked

Live GitHub API state matches the hash-bound unavailability report
No production credential is exposed to candidate qualification
